prompt:
A developer implemented retrieve as dynamic SQL so users can 'search anything'. The rest of the RAG pipeline (JSON + REST) is parameterized.

Why is this still unsafe, and what should retrieve be?
explanation: DP-800 production concern: AI-generated or user-tainted SQL. Retrieval must be parameterized (FT/vector). Parameterizing the REST payload does not retroactively fix a concatenated SELECT. LIKE on nvarchar is legal. EXEC(@sql) still exists — that is the problem.

options.text: Concatenating user text into SQL is injection. Use parameterized `CONTAINS` / `VECTOR_DISTANCE` (and keep RLS). Prompt injection into the **model** is a separate later control
`LIKE` cannot be used on nvarchar, so the batch cannot have run
RAG forbids reading the source table; you must only call the model
`EXEC` of a string is deprecated and fails on SQL Server 2025
